adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. This will deny access to users who are team admins but not owners, causing the subsequent permission check (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`) to incorrectly reject legitimate admins.
